missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for /v1/authorizations during the incident window
Payment dependency health (DB/upstream) to explain the 503
candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 as the deepest error in each failing checkout chain, while inventory reservation succeeds with 200.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; the internal cause of payment 503 (e.g. pool exhaustion, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout shows repeated 502s with low latency; traces consistently show payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations while inventory reservation succeeds, so the bounded candidate is an order-path failure rooted at payment. Payment-internal cause remains unproven.
